def solve(rows):

    a = t.tensor(rows)

            packed.data_ptr() == a.data_ptr(),
            packed.tolist())

    return einops.rearrange(imgs, '(g2 g1) h w c -> (g1 h) (g2 w) c', g1=rows)


example = (t.stack([t.full((2, 2, 1), float(k)) for k in range(6)]), 3)
print(solve(*example)[:, :, 0])
